# PerfCalcPro

> PerfCalcPro provides tools, guides, and calculators for PC gamers, hardware enthusiasts, and internet users who want better performance and smarter decisions.

## Tools
- [FPS Calculator](https://perfcalcpro.com/tools/fps-calculator): Estimate FPS based on your CPU, GPU, resolution, and settings.
- [DPS Calculator](https://perfcalcpro.com/tools/dps-calculator): Calculate damage per second for games and character builds.
- [Bottleneck Calculator](https://perfcalcpro.com/tools/bottleneck-calculator): Find whether your CPU or GPU is limiting your gaming performance.
- [XP Calculator](https://perfcalcpro.com/tools/xp-calculator): Track experience gains, leveling progress, and training efficiency.
- [Download Time Calculator](https://perfcalcpro.com/tools/download-time-calculator): Estimate download time from file size and internet speed.
- [EDPI Calculator](https://perfcalcpro.com/tools/edpi-calculator): Calculate effective DPI for aiming and mouse sensitivity.
- [Pokemon Type Calculator](https://perfcalcpro.com/tools/pokemon-type-calculator): Check type matchups and weaknesses.
- [Blox Fruits Calculator](https://perfcalcpro.com/tools/blox-fruits-calculator): Compare Blox Fruits values and trading worth.
- [VRAM Calculator for LLM](https://perfcalcpro.com/vram-calculator-for-llm): Estimate VRAM requirements for local AI and LLM workloads.
